intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. This page uses official BIMTECH fee information we opened in {{year}}, the recorded rows in our table, and the ranks we hold.
BIMTECH vs I Business Institute is a Greater Noida PGDM comparison. Read the programme names and the placement years carefully, and do not multiply year fees.

sections.heading: BIMTECH Greater vs I Business Institute for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose BIMTECH if you want a CAT and XAT listed PGDM, with a NIRF 2025 Management rank of 61, after you budget from the official tuition total rather than from our year rows.
On our records, BIMTECH has a 2024 insurance-business row of ₹16 lakh average and ₹23 lakh highest. Confirm the latest official report for the PGDM you would join.

Choose I Business Institute only after you confirm the official fee and the 2024 finance placement row. A recorded average of ₹21 lakh and a highest of ₹50 lakh are unusually strong next to BIMTECH's 2024 row, so check an official report.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: For BIMTECH we hold year tuition of ₹6.50 lakh on some PGDM rows and ₹7 lakh on others, plus one Total Fees year figure of ₹6.50 lakh. These are year rows, not confirmed official programme totals, and we have not multiplied them.
The official BIMTECH information for 2026–28 lists PGDM tuition of ₹14 lakh, with hostel charged separately. Use that official notice, not a doubled year row, when you budget.
For I Business Institute we hold Total Fees year figures of ₹4,92,500 on several PGDM specialisations and ₹5,27,500 on one row. We have not multiplied those year figures.
Confirm the current notices on bimtech.ac.in and ibi.edu.in before you pay.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: BIMTECH has a 2024 PGDM Insurance Business row of ₹16 lakh average and ₹23 lakh highest. Older insurance-business rows are also stored; do not mix pre-2020 figures with this 2024 record.
I Business Institute has a 2024 PGDM Finance row of ₹21 lakh average and ₹50 lakh highest, and a 2020 finance row of ₹9 lakh average and ₹35 lakh highest.

The IBI 2024 figures are unusually high next to BIMTECH's recorded 2024 insurance-business row. Ask IBI for the official 2024 report, and ask BIMTECH for the flagship PGDM report if you need a wider picture than insurance business.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: BIMTECH is listed with CAT and XAT. I Business Institute is listed with CAT. Confirm each school's current official admission note.

On our records, BIMTECH has a NIRF 2025 Management rank of 61, after 48 in 2023. I Business Institute has a Times 2024 rank of 100 and no NIRF row here. Confirm the current NIRF list on nirfindia.org.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are private institutes recorded in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, so a local student can visit them on the same trip.
BIMTECH is a dedicated management campus with several recorded PGDM streams, including international business, retail and insurance. Match the exact programme, not only the city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick BIMTECH if the NIRF 2025 rank of 61 and a PGDM at that campus are the goal, after you have budgeted from the official ₹14 lakh tuition total.
Pick I Business Institute only if that is the seat you have, after official fee confirmation and after you have seen the official 2024 placement report.
Do not multiply year fees, and do not treat the IBI 2024 highest of ₹50 lakh as settled until an official report confirms it.
